statement_en: Every complex $n\times n$ matrix $A$ is unitarily similar to an upper triangular matrix $T$, that is, there exists a unitary matrix $Q$ such that $$A=QTQ^{\dagger},$$ and the diagonal entries of $T$ are the eigenvalues of $A$.
callout_body: n阶复矩阵$A$酉相似(unitary similarity)于一个上三角矩阵$T$,即存在一个酉矩阵(unitary matrix)$Q$使得$$A=QTQ^{\dagger}$$并且上三角矩阵$T$的对角线为矩阵$A$的特征值。
